note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026), Palestinian Territory, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahwealj992) and average post-tax disposable income (adiincj992) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. The database's metadata labels the figures ILS, but its market exchange rate in local currency per US dollar (xlcusxi999) is 1 for 2024, and per euro 1.08, the dollar's, so they are read as USD, as the database's own rates show them to be. Read 2026-10-30.
